title: Independent review verdict file ($EV/reviews/<gate-or-wp>[-<item>][-r<n>].json or $EV/reviews/CPA-merge-<run_id>.json)
description: Format of every [REVIEW] verdict file of tasks.md (docs/21 section 4.4 and IC-46, the plan owner's held-commit rules after the review of commit af664ed0) and of every merge-review file $EV/reviews/CPA-merge-<run_id>.json, the file that the commit-push script itself names in the Awaits-Review: line of a merge commit it made (tasks.md T040, T042; docs/21 IC-53; contracts revision 9). Producer: the reviewing stream ST-REV, never the stream that made the change (FR-023, constitution 11.4.142, 11.4.240). Consumers: the commit-push script stage S6, which releases a held commit (one whose message carries `Awaits-Review: <this file's path>`) only when this file is committed in the main repository's HEAD with verdict GO and its covers_runs lists the held commit's CPA-Run id; stage S5, which refuses a new hold on a file that already holds GO, in the main repository's HEAD or in the same declared change set, and any change to such a file (exit 20, reason verdict_already_go), and refuses a declared GO whose covers_runs lacks a held commit, in the unpushed range of any owned repository, that awaits the file (exit 20, reason verdict_covers_incomplete; contracts revision 9); the register importer of review rows (docs/04 reg_reviews: GO or NO-GO, model and effort). covers_runs lists every commit the review read, each by repository path (`.` for the main repository, otherwise the submodule path from the main repository root), commit sha and the CPA-Run id from that commit's trailer; it may be empty when the reviewed change is not committed yet (a task that commits only after its GO), and such a verdict releases no held commit. model and effort record what actually performed the review (constitution 11.4.209: Opus at xhigh); effort `?` records that the dispatch path could not set or report it (11.4.231(F.2)), never a claimed xhigh. blocking_findings is required (contracts revision 8): 0 on a GO and at least 1 on a NO-GO, so a GO can never carry an open blocking finding or omit the count (docs/16 section 12.2.4 (e); the round-9 content review of commit b9412d06 found a GO without the field VALID). File name: <gate-or-wp>, an optional -<item> for one item of a package (for example WP-39R-code) and an optional -r<n> for a later review iteration, which holds work made after an earlier GO (tasks.md abbreviation table); or CPA-merge-<run_id> for a merge-review file. Every 40-hex commit sha of covers_runs is a bare hex string, which passes the commit-push S2 secret fold only through the hex filter of .secrets.baseline (tasks.md T040a), never through an exemption. Validated only against synthetic fixtures (no verdict file exists yet); see contracts/README.md. The optional field foreign_outside_candidate (contracts revision 10) is typed below. Other fields a task records (findings, reviewer-authored mutations, gate-specific checks) are allowed.

gate.description: the gate or work package reviewed, for example G-GATE or WP-04

author.description: the stream that produced the reviewed change; the register importer refuses a verdict whose author equals its reviewer (docs/04 reg_reviews), a cross-field rule JSON Schema cannot express

reviewer.description: the reviewing stream or agent, never the producing stream

repository.description: `.` or a path relative to the main repository root, no leading or trailing slash

cpa_run.description: the run id of the commit's `CPA-Run:` trailer: UTC start time to the second, process id, random suffix

blocking_findings.description: number of blocking findings open at this verdict: 0 on a GO, at least 1 on a NO-GO (constitution 11.4.134: a review iterates to zero blocking findings)

foreign_outside_candidate.description: contracts revision 10 (tasks.md rev 12 T308a, T582, T583; docs/21 IC-58): optional, written only in the merge-review file of a main-repository merge made after the T566 release candidate was built whose incoming range is made only of another actor's commits (no CPA-Run trailer); one entry per such commit that changes a non-test path, with those paths (paths relative to the main repository root); the listed commits are the main repository's ODG-41 kind, never a reason to withhold the merge's GO; an empty list states that no such commit changes a non-test path

items.description: a non-test path that the commit changes, relative to the main repository root, no leading or trailing slash
